title: VoxCeleb2 extra speakers + extra samples of FLAG_53, part 0 only (1 235 new + 4 877 old speakers; 36 426 faces, 47 529 voices)

modes.train: not run by default: collect stages run only when forced (configs/modes.json collect_kind_runs_only_when_forced) and every collected dataset is read from FF_DATA/01_collected (class 'collected' is in always_saved_classes). Re-collecting: force the whole collect closure in ONE run, with a fresh FF_WORK and FF_USE_SAVED=collected (README.md of 11_collect): FF_FORCE=c37_vox2,c53_vox2b,c46_voxblink,c45_frames_vox2,c_frames_index,c63_frames,c87_frames_bridge,c63v_audio_cache. Forcing this stage alone mixes its new rows with the old frames / audio cache (sampling is not deterministic).

compute.note: part 0 took 29 064 s in the original log (faces 8 790 s, voices ~20 270 s); the whole run incl. the dropped experiment 30 752 s. the design estimate of 1.5-2.5 h was wrong. HF_TOKEN: gated repo (not needed at the time)

env_note: FLAG_LOCAL / FLAG_SMOKE pinned to "0" so a value left in the caller's environment cannot switch the notebook into its local / smoke mode during a real run (smoke_env sets "1" under FF_SMOKE=1). FLAG_IN / FLAG_OUT would also bypass the runner's /kaggle paths if set by the caller and cannot be pinned here (a fixed value would be wrong): WP-A drops them from the inherited environment; never export them.

# [FF pin] HF revision parameter added for the reproduction repo (CHANGES.md): FF_HF_REVS = JSON {"<repo id>": "<commit>"};
    # unset, or a repo not listed -> "main" = the original behaviour (the original run read resolve/main, unpinned).
    FF_HF_REV = lambda repo: __import__("json").loads(__import__("os").environ.get("FF_HF_REVS") or "{}").get(repo, "main")
    # [FF url] ProgramComputer/voxceleb became gated (auto-approved terms) after the run: token from the environment only, never

    FF_HF_HDR = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + __import__("os").environ["HF_TOKEN"]} if __import__("os").environ.get("HF_TOKEN") else {}
    HF = "https://huggingface.co/datasets/ProgramComputer/voxceleb/resolve/" + FF_HF_REV("ProgramComputer/voxceleb") + "/vox2/"

skip_with_requires.why: skip_with is served as a saved copy of the KERNEL output (runner); the only consumer of the kernel output, c_frames_index, needs these three files under a folder named feats_vox2b. The published feats-vox2b-p holds the face meta but not the two listings: copy them from the frames-index dataset (vox2b/listing_dev_mp4.parquet sha256 49ac66949802fb5b…, vox2b/listing_test_mp4.parquet 6b560e7733249460…) into FF_DATA/01_collected/voxceleb2_flag53/feats_vox2b/ (the layout of design §3.1). Without them a forced c_frames_index stops at its find() assertion.

run_policy: Sampling is not deterministic (broken tar streams / failed range reads are skipped, spares fill in): a re-collection gives other rows than the arrays every later stage was trained on, so the 13.54 chain ALWAYS uses the collected data (skip_with). FLAG_53 picks NV + 4 spare voice candidates per speaker (68 733 candidates -> 47 529 clips kept) and lost 18 face reads.
private_why: VoxCeleb2-derived features; aligned with configs/data_map.json (feats-vox2b-p private)
notes: 'dev' in E2E_SPLIT is the SAFE-04 lab mode name of the FLAG_53 notebook (cell 7 extracts only when SPLIT == 'dev'), not the organiser dev set; no organiser data is read by part 0.
Kernel output also holds feats_vox2b/listing_{dev,test}_{mp4,aac}.parquet (remote zip central directories) and parts_*/: c_frames_index takes listing_{dev,test}_mp4.parquet + face_meta.csv from here.
The 117 VoxCeleb2 TEST speakers of kind 'new' have their audio only in vox2_test_aac.zip: their 936 wanted clips are the 936 clips missing from the audio cache (c63v, G22; checked by counts 18/11).
